construct: SCN5A encodes the major cardiac voltage-gated sodium-channel alpha subunit. Loss-of-function variants reduce inward sodium current, impairing phase-0 depolarization and conduction and predisposing to characteristic right-precordial ST-segment abnormalities and malignant ventricular arrhythmias.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Fever-unmasked coved ST elevation in V1-V2, nocturnal syncope, family sudden death, and a loss-of-function SCN5A variant identify Brugada syndrome with reduced fast sodium current.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: SCN5A can also be involved in long-QT type 3, but that phenotype is associated with altered persistent sodium current and QT prolongation rather than the Brugada ECG pattern specified.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The genotype direction and right-precordial ECG phenotype uniquely support reduced phase-0 inward sodium current.
